'''Corridor CC Four-Oh-Eight-Seven''' was a corridor on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]. The mining site of [[Anyat-en]] was located approximately 150 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] along the corridor.<ref name="Choices" />
